name: Recursive Teaching Dimension of Singleton–Cosingleton Classes
proof: The minimum-teaching value proof \ref{val:minimum_teaching_set_size_singleton_cosingleton} shows that every target initially has teaching size three. Hence the first recursive teaching step costs at least three. The same size-three teachers remain valid after targets are removed, giving a recursive teaching plan of width at most three. Therefore RTD is exactly three.
references: Local definition-driven proof and exact finite replay in sync/verify_singleton_cosingleton.py. The class was already used in the survey's signed intersection-completion argument.
